A big one for TC002 owners, and a few things everyone will enjoy. Update from HACS, restart Home Assistant, and you're set: your apps keep working as they are.

## ✨ What's new

### 🖥️ Your TC002 finally uses its whole screen
On a Ulanzi TC002 running AWTRIX NG, apps used to be drawn at double size, so most texts had to scroll. A simple app can now use all 52 × 16 LEDs, sharp and pixel for pixel. Open an app, pick a **Layout**, and choose what fits:

- **Value**: one big, easy-to-read value.
- **Title and value**: a small title above the value, like `Pool` over `27.5°C`.
- **Value and progress bar**: perfect for a battery or a tank.
- **Two entities, one per line**: indoor and outdoor temperature at a glance.

The icon is optional, and gallery icons are drawn at 16 × 16 so they don't look tiny next to the text. You can pick the fonts too, among those that stay legible on the clock. The preview shows the result exactly as the clock will draw it.

Not into layouts? Nothing changes: your apps stay on one line until you pick one.

### 🖼️ Your clock's own icons, right in the panel
On AWTRIX NG too, the icons you stored on the clock now show in the panel: on the app cards, on the simulated screen and next to the icon field. On a TC002, 16 × 16 icons show in full detail.

Animated icons from the LaMetric gallery are now saved on AWTRIX NG clocks once, like on AWTRIX 3, instead of being sent again with every update.

### 📏 A unit of your own
Next to **Show the unit**, type the unit you want. Turn a bare `750` into `750 GB`, or show `kWh` instead of `kW`. Leave it empty to keep the entity's own. Each entity has its own, on a line or in a layout.

## 🛠️ Fixed
- 🎨 **Colors on a line of entities (AWTRIX 3).** When several entities shared a line, they all ended up in the same color. Each one now keeps its own, including colors that follow a gradient.
- 🧩 **Icons on AWTRIX NG before 1.2.** These versions could not read the icons sent with an app (the clock's log said `inline icon is not a JPEG the decoder can read`). Awtrix Studio now checks the clock's version and speaks its language. We still recommend updating the clock to AWTRIX NG 1.2 or newer, so that animated icons play.
- 🖼️ **Icons that came and went.** Some larger icons stored on the clock showed in the panel only now and then. They now show every time, on AWTRIX 3 too.
- 🧹 **A stray "null"** in the app editor, under the display options, is gone.
- 🔧 A Home Assistant warning about how the clock's device was looked up no longer shows in your logs.

## ⬆️ Updating
Nothing to do: your apps, icons and settings are kept. On a TC002, try a layout on one of your apps to see the difference. 😉
